page.summary: Turn an accessible chest into a predictable Med-Kit when healing supply is missing, then use or hand off the kit before farming another.

verdict.recommendation: Choose Pharmacy for a deliberate in-Trial medical supply plan when bringing a Med-Kit directly is not the better answer.
verdict.soloQ: Use the first safe chest when a Med-Kit would change the next heal; do not spend a rescue window searching for more stock.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Name who needs the kit and where it can be passed before assigning someone to chest duty.
verdict.mainWeakness: Unopened chest access, travel and Killer pressure can make the guaranteed output arrive too late.

options.whyItsHere: Makes an unlocked chest produce the medical item this subtype is built around, reducing uncertainty in the healing-supply decision.
Locates chests when finding one safely is the constraint; its general item-rarity value is secondary to Pharmacy's medical output.

weaknesses: A guaranteed kit still costs the perk slot, chest access and time that a pregame item would avoid.
commonMistakes: Opening extra chests while a usable Med-Kit is already idle.
Assuming Pharmacy supplies an item without first unlocking a chest.

opening: Decide before the Trial whether the intended healing supply is worth a perk slot and chest detour rather than bringing a Med-Kit directly.

rows.situation: An unopened chest is safely reachable and the team lacks a Med-Kit for an upcoming heal.
rows.action: Unlock it with Pharmacy, then take or deliver the Med-Kit to the survivor who can use it next.
rows.why: The output is specified; the decision is whether the heal will repay the chest trip.

rows.situation: A medical need exists but the nearest chest is unknown.
rows.action: Use the chest aura to choose a reachable chest on the team's route; skip a distant chest if the healing need will pass first.
rows.why: Finding a chest is helpful only while the medical window remains open.

rows.situation: A usable Med-Kit has been supplied, or Killer pressure makes another chest trip unsafe.
rows.action: Stop farming and return to healing, repair or the urgent rescue.
rows.why: Unused inventory is not a team reset.

abortWhen: Skip the chest when an immediate rescue or safe heal matters more than future kit supply.
Stop once kits are available but cannot be used or delivered promptly.
